meta.title: Optimize datatype CLI performance by skipping accessor loop for 0-ary constructors
meta.body_summary: Fix performance regression in datatype CLI by skipping accessor loop for 0-ary constructors, with profiling and timing evidence showing improvement from 4s to 3s for 50k constructors.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot fixed performance at call site; maintainer redirected to utility function; after fix, PR closed as maintainer integrated separately.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 14 changed lines across two files, this is a very small fix by absolute volume. It fits a tiny performance tweak that was not merged but instead closed after the maintainer integrated a similar fix separately.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer NikolajBjorner requested that the performance fix be implemented inside `get_constructor_accessors()` and `get_constructor_recognizer()` rather than at the call site, to make them efficient for 0-ary constructors.
review_details.performance_claim: Skip accessor loop for 0-ary constructors to reduce CLI processing time from 4s to 3s for 50,000 constructors.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR after incorporating a similar fix separately (commit 8de80e666b1dd3b6e55cf3ff26e71073a7899685 referenced). PR was not merged but the fix was applied.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot correctly identified performance bottleneck and produced a fix, but needed maintainer guidance to move the optimization to the proper utility function location, demonstrating that placement of optimizations in complex C++ codebases may require domain knowledge.

detection_detail.code_reading: NikolajBjorner reviewed the proposed fix in cmd_context.cpp and directed the optimization to the util functions for better encapsulation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes profiling data, timing benchmarks (4s→3s for 50k constructors), and a concrete SMT2 example that can reproduce the issue.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After Copilot updated the utility function per maintainer request, the maintainer closed the PR, apparently having incorporated the fix in a separate commit (referenced in timeline).

core_change_summary.description: Added early return in `get_constructor_accessors()` when arity is 0 to avoid expensive datatype definition lookup; originally, a call-site guard was added in `cmd_context::dt_eh::operator()` to skip the loop for 0-ary constructors.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The initial commit added a guard in cmd_context.cpp; the follow-up commit moved the optimization into get_constructor_accessors.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (a0168d80): Added `if (c->get_arity() > 0)` guard before accessor loop in cmd_context.cpp.
Maintainer comment: suggested fixing get_constructor_accessors and get_constructor_recognizer directly.
Follow-up commit (fcbf9a07): Added early return in get_constructor_accessors() when arity==0.

review_signals.summary: Suggested fixing the performance issue in `get_constructor_recognizer` and `get_constructor_accessors` directly instead of at the call site.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot moved the optimization into get_constructor_accessors.

review_signals.summary: Confirmed that get_constructor_accessors was optimized with early return for 0-ary constructors.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with initial call-site guard fix linked to issue #7709.
Maintainer NikolajBjorner commented to fix the utility functions directly.
Copilot responded with a follow-up commit optimizing get_constructor_accessors.
Maintainer referenced the PR in a separate commit and closed the PR without merging.
